short_description: UltraTech Portland Pozzolana Cement, 50 kg bag. Fly-ash blended cement to IS 1489 (Part 1) for RCC, masonry and plaster work.
long_description:
## What it is

UltraTech Portland Pozzolana Cement is a fly-ash blended grey cement supplied in a 50 kg HDPE/PP laminated woven bag. It is made by the dry process: high-quality clinker of balanced chemical composition is inter-ground with fly ash containing high reactive silica and high-purity gypsum, or high-quality Ordinary Portland Cement is blended with finer fly ash. The blend conforms to IS 1489 (Part 1), the Indian Standard for fly-ash based Portland Pozzolana Cement, and as a blended cement it carries no numeric strength grade.

## What it's for

This is a general-purpose cement for construction in all applications, including RCC, PCC, masonry and plastering. Because the pozzolanic reaction cuts permeability, UltraTech also positions it for marine structures, hydraulic constructions, dams, underground basements and sewerage systems, where resistance to chemical attack and protection against corrosion of steel matter most. In ordinary house building it suits foundation, column, beam and slab concrete around M15 to M30, at a typical water–cement ratio near 0.45.

## Key specifications

Mill testing against IS 1489 (Part 1) returned 28.6 MPa compressive strength at 3 days and 58 MPa at 28 days, with an initial setting time of 150 minutes and a final set at 225 minutes — a long working window that suits hand placement in warm weather. Chloride content is held at 0.035% and insoluble residue at 22.80% by mass. Fineness is around 340 m²/kg Blaine, specific gravity about 2.9, standard consistency about 30%, and Le Chatelier soundness expansion about 1 mm. The composition runs roughly 66% clinker, 30% fly ash and 4% gypsum.

## Application and installation notes

Mix the dry constituents until uniform, then add water gradually to the design ratio; place and compact within about 30 minutes. Blended cements gain strength more slowly than OPC, so cure with water for a full 14 days. Work between 5 °C and 40 °C ambient. Store bags off the floor on wooden planks, clear of external walls, in a dry covered godown, stacked no more than 10 high, and use within 3 months of packing.

## What's in the box

One 50 kg sealed bag, approximately 450 × 700 × 140 mm.
